newsitem.title: INDIA: India's gold output rises in April-September.
newsitem.headline: India's gold output rises in April-September.

text.p: India's gold metal production in the first six months of fiscal 1996/97 (April-March) rose to 900.92 kilogrammes from 852.64 in the same period in 1995/96, a mines ministry statement said on Wednesday.
The government had set a target of 908.79 kgs of gold production for the period between April and September 1996.
India produced 205.30 kgs of the metal in September 1996 against a target of 153.76 set for the month, the statement said.
